title: Brief
description: Interface design brief drawn from the prototypes made in Design. One brief per intent. It is written so rafters, the /design agent and a human can each use it without opening the prototypes' canvases first. Every statement names the prototypes it comes from, by the ids listed under `prototypes`, so a reader can open the canvas behind any line and a statement with no prototype behind it cannot be written.

intent.description: Id of the intent document the prototypes were made for

summary.description: What the interface is for and who uses it, in a paragraph a reader can act on without opening anything else

prototypes.description: The prototype pointers the brief is drawn from

id.description: Local id that statements cite in `from`, e.g. P1

canvas.description: Link to the prototype's Design canvas

explores.description: The part of the interface the prototype explores

parts.description: The parts of the interface, each with what the prototypes show about it

purpose.description: What the person or agent does in this part

statements.description: What the prototypes show about this part: what it holds, what can be done there, how it responds, its states

open.description: What the prototypes leave unsettled, so no reader settles it silently

from.description: Ids of the prototypes, listed under `prototypes`, this comes from
